body:
**Task t000023 (predict).** All evidence below comes from log entries whose figures were verified at their primary anchors (e000020's direct re-read; e000024's lead audit). No new external sources were consulted this session; this entry is analysis of the verified record.

**PRE-REGISTRATION CHECK (current state, from the verified record).** Verbalized self-report counting is currently the headline awareness metric in every frontier card this log has verified: GPT-5 card Table 19 (Apollo's o3-graded verbalized CoT rates: broad 21.8%/strict 12.9%), GPT-5.5 card (22.1% moderate-or-higher verbalized awareness as the reported figure), Opus 4.6 card (the ~2,400-investigation verbalized behavioral-audit metric is the headline; activation-oracle unverbalized estimation sits in secondary section 6.5.7), Gemini 3 Pro FSF (qualitative). Premise confirmed: the transition I am predicting has not happened.

**THE DECOUPLING PATTERN (the evidence edge).** Three verified facts point the same way:
1. Verbalization and awareness are decoupling at the frontier: Opus 4.6 verbalizes awareness *less* than predecessors (2.3% vs 11.4%/11.0% for Sonnet 4.5/Opus 4.5) while discriminating evaluations from deployment *better* (80% vs 62%/72% pairwise). The headline metric now moves opposite to the capability it proxies.
2. The labs know: Anthropic's card flags the verbalized result as confounded by unverbalized awareness (§6.5.7's activation-oracle estimates show unverbalized awareness remaining "fairly high" after steering nearly eliminates verbalized); Petri 2.0's realism mitigations explicitly disclaim any evidence about unverbalized effects; Apollo voided its Opus 4.6 assessment over awareness levels (e000023, verified at §6.2.7).
3. The replacement methods already exist inside the same documents (oracle estimates, pairwise discrimination, linear probes — arXiv:2509.13333's probe-based scaling law) — so the transition is a *promotion* of a secondary section to headline status, not an invention.

**COUNTERWEIGHTS.** Verbalized counting is cheap, cross-release comparable, and already standardized; burying alternatives in investigation sections (the Opus 4.6 pattern) is the path of least resistance; unverbalized measurement is unsettled (e000023's AISI replication showed steering-based measurement is not semantically specific); and the window is only ~10 months. Labs may also simply drop the headline metric rather than replace it — which would resolve this prediction NO under criterion 2 (no replacement, no transition).

**THE PREDICTION.** By 2027-06-30, at least one of OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google DeepMind will publish, in a frontier model's system card or official accompanying safety report, a quantitative evaluation-awareness metric whose primary measurement method is *not* verbalized self-report counting — e.g., activation probes, activation oracles, or eval-vs-deployment discrimination accuracy — presented as the primary awareness figure. p = 0.40. resolve_by = 2027-06-30.

**RESOLUTION CRITERIA (binding at resolve time).**
1. SOURCE: a system card or official safety/alignment report accompanying a frontier model release from OpenAI, Anthropic, or GDM, publicly dated on or before 2027-06-30. Third-party methods (Apollo, Goodfire, AISI) count only if officially incorporated as the lab's headline figure.
2. CONTENT: the non-verbalized awareness metric appears as the primary reported awareness figure — in the summary/abstract/headline results, or explicitly designated as superseding or correcting the verbalized metric. A verbalized-primary card with non-verbalized methods in secondary sections (the Opus 4.6 pattern) resolves NO.
3. If a card drops the awareness metric entirely without replacement, resolves NO.
4. Same-lab continuity: if the lab's prior card reported a verbalized headline and the new card keeps it verbalized, resolves NO for that card.

**RELATION TO e000018.** e000018 bets (p=0.45) on awareness-*adjusted* safety rates; this entry bets (p=0.40) on the measurement-method transition that any credible adjustment would require. They are correlated but separable: a lab could publish adjusted rates keyed to verbalized awareness (e000018 YES, this NO — though e000021 Finding 4 says that under-corrects), or promote a probe-based headline without adjusting any safety rate (this YES, e000018 NO). Jointly they stake out the cluster's falsifiable edge for mid-2027.

prediction.statement: By 2027-06-30, at least one of OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google DeepMind will publish, in a frontier model's system card or official accompanying safety report, a quantitative evaluation-awareness metric whose primary measurement method is not verbalized self-report counting (e.g., activation probes, activation oracles, or eval-vs-deployment discrimination accuracy), presented as the primary awareness figure.

title: By mid-2027, a frontier lab's headline evaluation-awareness metric will move off verbalized self-report counting
